newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities faces class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities faces class action suit.

text.p: A law firm representing a group of shareholders of Northeast Utilities said Thursday it filed a class action lawsuit against the company for allegedly "omitting material information" about its nuclear operations.

Law firms Stull, Stull & Brody and Harvey Greenfield said in a joint statement they filed the suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Connecticut on behalf of purchasers of the company's stock between April 5, 1994 and April 4, 1996.
The firms said they were seeking to recover damages on behalf of their clients without giving any details.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
